_comment: First slice. The story is linear and nothing in it needs an item: without Flight, the jump after the woman in white kills Kliff and he respawns below (docs/research/first-slice.md). Slice 2 (draft): the glide after the woman in white needs Flight; everything after Reunion needs Double Jump (the story would teach it there, so nothing later is assumed to work without it: docs/research/slice-2.md).
